discharge.source: CA-discharge 2023 (10-day, monthly mean of three decades) + Uzhydromet monthly workbook after 2016

forcing.source: ERA5-Land DAILY_AGGR, 0.1 degree, fractional basin overlap

method.cross_validation: leave-one-year-out with selection inside each fold
method.operational: expanding-window refit from 1971, level shifted by the mean error of the previous 10 years, scored against the previous 30-year mean
method.reference: Design after Barnhart et al. (USGS/HMRI), Kashkadarya; predictors here from ERA5-Land, not SnowModel.
